body:
Step 3 of docs/ios-port-design.md. The iOS shell: an Xcode project (ios/) that hosts the shared UI
in a UIViewController, wires the iOS platform implementations, and builds on a hosted macOS CI
service that signs and uploads to TestFlight. First milestone: log in, overview, open a list, add
and check items, sync while open, multi-account as on Android. Blocked until the maintainer picks
the CI service (depends on where the repo is hosted upstream) and has an Apple Developer account.
title: iPhone port step 3: the iOS shell, built on hosted macOS CI, TestFlight
